faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Defender P525 use?
faqLeft.a: It uses the AJ133 — a 5.0-litre supercharged V8. The P525 badge denotes a specific power tune.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Defender P525 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Defender P525?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine spec.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ133 Defender P525 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every P525 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Defender P525 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Defender P525 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Defender P525 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Defender P525 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
